issue.title: just check fails at lint (toobig): tests/service/test_service_host_scenarios.py has 1242 lines (limit 1000)
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** just _lint-toobig

Found while splitting src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_agent_enter_targets.py into focused modules. just toobig reports 'VIOLATION: tests/service/test_service_host_scenarios.py has 1242 lines (limit: 1000)'. That test file is untouched by the split (git status shows only the enter-targets modules and their test changed), so the violation is pre-existing. Remediation per the gate: split the oversized scenario file into smaller modules.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic line-count gate failure on a file untouched by the working tree changes; line counts do not vary between runs.

evidence.note: Relayed by sase-16h.land from PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP sase-16h.4#1; independently reproduced at master 4022cfe59: just _lint-toobig still reports tests/service/test_service_host_scenarios.py at 1242 lines (limit 1000), failing the toobig stage of just check.
